subject: Demo request: OpenLib + Redwood GitHub integration questions
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir@openlib.org>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request: OpenLib + Redwood GitHub integration questions

Hi Camila,

We just signed up and are evaluating Redwood for a GitHub-based workflow at OpenLib. We liked the model routing and caching features on the docs - curious how the GitHub integration works (webhooks, manifests, and recommended auth patterns). Would love a short 30-min demo to walk through integration options and any examples you have for open-source projects.

A couple of quick context points:
- We're a small infra team running CI via GitHub Actions and prefer token-based auth.
- Priority: low latency inference for code search + embeddings across repos.

I'm in PST. Open times this week: Tue 3/2 11:00-13:00 PT or Wed 3/3 14:00-16:00 PT. If those don't work I can propose alternatives.

Attaching a rough integration diagram we use to collect questions.

Attachment: integration_diagram.pdf (PDF, 125KB)

Thanks,
Samir Khan
Platform Engineer | OpenLib
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir@openlib.org>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:28:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request: Demo request: OpenLib + Redwood GitHub integration questions

Hi Samir - great to hear from you and welcome to Redwood!

Happy to run a 30-min walkthrough focused on integration patterns for GitHub Actions and token-based auth. I have availability Tue 3/2 11:30 PT and Wed 3/3 14:30 PT. You can grab a slot here if either works: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/30min

If you can share a bit more about expected throughput (tokens/sec per repo) and whether you'd want public or private model variants, I can loop in our AE and a solutions engineer so we can answer architecture questions live.

Looking forward to it -
Camila Reyes
Senior SDR | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Samir Khan <samir@openlib.org>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 10:05:43 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request: Demo request: OpenLib + Redwood GitHub integration questions

Thanks Camila - 11:30 PT on Tue works better for me than the earlier slot. I also prefer Wed 3/3 14:30 PT if that ends up being easier for your AE.

Throughput: roughly 5-10 requests/sec at peak across CI jobs, but many short bursts. We care about both embeddings and code generation latency.

Quick note: the diagram I attached has our network topology and a proposed proxy in front of GitHub Actions runners. If you need anything else in advance we can share more.

- Samir

Thanks for confirming, Samir - I booked Tue 3/2 11:30 PT on your behalf. I'm looping in Alex Martinez (AE) who will join to cover pricing and integration reference architectures.

- Confirm which repos you want indexed for embeddings
